lessons.title: Hormonal Messengers: The Endocrine System & The HPA Stress Axis
lessons.description: Distinguish peptide vs. steroid hormones, hypothalamic releasing factors, pituitary master control, and the HPA cortisol feedback loop.

lessons.title: Biological Clocks: The Suprachiasmatic Nucleus & Circadian Rhythms
lessons.description: Explore circadian master pacemaking: SCN molecular clocks, retinohypothalamic blue light cues, and pineal melatonin synthesis.

lessons.title: The Architecture of Sleep: NREM Stages, REM Paradox, & Sleep Cycles
lessons.description: Master polysomnography: EEG sleep wave progression, N1, N2 spindles/K-complexes, N3 slow-wave sleep, and REM atonia.

lessons.title: Why We Sleep: Memory Consolidation, Glymphatic Waste Clearance, & Sleep Pathology
lessons.description: Examine memory replay, synaptic downscaling, glymphatic amyloid clearance, and disorders including narcolepsy and REM behavior disorder.
